notes.title: Multi-Export Patch
notes.notes:
Welcome Everyone,

Windows Update had caused a bit of an issue with Virtual Battlemap's ability to export images more than one at a time. We've had a team working on this for a while, and it is now...

[h1]RESOLVED!![/h1]

[i]Enjoy exporting all you like.. using the "[u]Numpad Number Keys[/u]" for [Web Quality] exports and the "[u]F Number Keys[/u]" for the [Print Quality] Exports![/i]


[b]** Thank you for being patient while we resolved this issue![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.60 (Quick Patch)
notes.notes:
Hello,

We are happy to announce that a shader that failed to compile in the last update has been fixed.

The issue it caused was a failure to display any textures on the Nature DLC Background Mountains.. making them appear Pink.

Thank you to Matt Metcalfe for pointing out this issue today so we could fix it.

Have fun making maps,
Virtual Battlemap Team

notes.title: Patch Version 1.19 released
notes.notes:
This patch is an ease of use patch and a preperation for the Overrland DLC.

[h1]Ease of Use Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] the Delete key can now be used to delete objects
[*] Snap is enabled by defult when first placing an item
[/list]

[h1]Overland DLC Preperation[/h1]

[list]
[*] [NUMPAD *] Move to Top Layer (When Tile is Selected in edit mode)
[*] [NUMPAD +] Move to Middle Layer (When Tile is Selected in edit mode)
[*] [NUMPAD -] Move to Bottom Layer (When Tile is Selected in edit mode)
[*] Help screen updated with this info
[/list]

notes.title: Virtual Battlemap Patch 1.15
notes.notes:
This is a small patch to make better use of memory (run better on lower end machines) and a fix to a "Pink" missing texture that took us a bit longer to find and than we wanted it to.

Thank you for using Virtual battlemap :)

** More content is in the works!

notes.title: Virtual Battlemap Version 1.04 Update
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/GISTanB5B4M

[h1]Virtual Battlemap Version 1.04 Update[/h1]

The top down camera allows for unlimited map sized that you choose by setting your camera anywhere and using the "Export View" Buttons.
Hiding the GUI lets you use the software with an In-Table TV or Projector making game play support much better!

[h1]Added[/h1]
[list]
[*]Top Down Camera View
[*]Hide GUI (Interface)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.02 and Next DLC Preview!

In the image above you can see one of the benefits of this update, as well as a sneak peek look at our next DLC (Interiors).

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Selected objects now have a selection box
[*] Your View can now move through objects to make sure you can get the view you want.. while building and exporting with the (F9,9) POV camera.
[/list]
